snippet.title: BUCKSHOT ROULETTE | 10 MILLION HIGH ROLLERS | PlayStation & Nintendo Switch Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
10 MILLION HIGH ROLLERS HAVE TAKEN THEIR SEATS.

Buckshot Roulette is coming soon to PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.
AVAILABLE NOW on Steam, XBOXSeries X|S, XBOX on PC and XBOX Game Pass. Load the shotgun and test your luck.

GET IT ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835570/Buckshot_Roulette/
